await (async (page) => { const failures=[];page.on('response',r=>{if(r.status()>=400)failures.push({url:r.url(),status:r.status()})});await page.reload();await page.setViewportSize({width:375,height:812});await page.evaluate(()=>document.fonts.ready);const tasks=await page.locator('.gateway-paths a').allTextContents();await page.getByRole('link',{name:'Understand aDNA',exact:true}).click();const reached={url:page.url(),h1:await page.locator('h1').innerText()};await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:4466/');await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Toggle dark mode'}).click();await page.evaluate(async()=>{await Promise.all(document.getAnimations().filter(a=>a.effect?.getTiming().iterations!==Infinity).map(a=>a.finished.catch(()=>{})))});return {tasks,reached,theme:await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.className),failures}; })(page);
